statement_en: The trace of a matrix is linear. That is, for two $n\times n$ matrices $A,B$, one has $$\text{trace}(aA+bB)=a\,\text{trace}(A)+b\,\text{trace}(B),$$ where $a,b$ are constants.
callout_body: 矩阵的迹是线性的。即如果有两个n阶方程$A,B$那么成立等式$$\text{trace}(aA+bB)=a\,\text{trace}(A)+b\,\text{trace}(B)$$其中$a,b$是两个常数。
